limitations: Detected cells and OCR are unverified candidates; text presence cannot establish field roles.
Repeated full-page and region views describe the same rows; do not duplicate them.
Evidence proves substring presence, not the correct field or row assignment.
Arithmetic consistency cannot prove values match the source document.
Model self-confidence is not a calibrated confidence signal.

Quantity-only delivery notes do not require monetary operands; unavailable arithmetic stays not_applicable.
